newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian envoy confirmed dead in Ethiopia crash.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian envoy confirmed dead in Ethiopia crash.

text.p: Hungary's ambassador to Nairobi, Antal Annus, was killed in the crash of a hijacked Ethiopian airliner over the weekend, officials said on Tuesday.
"We can now confirm that he was one of the victims," foreign ministry spokesman Gabor Szentivanyi told Reuters.
Annus, 55, was an army general who negotiated the withdrawal of Soviet troops from Hungary in 1991 after they had been stationed here for 47 years.

Married and a father of two, he was undersecretary at the defence ministry from 1990 to 1993, before joining the foreign ministry. He was appointed Hungary's ambassador to Ethiopia and Kenya in July 1993.
